subject.title: [Bug] "Cannot convert undefined or null to object" in 2026.3.2 with google-vertex/gemini-3.1-pro-preview

question: Should the Google Vertex sanitizer fix be held for redacted live Vertex/Gemini CLI proof, or should maintainers accept source-level proof and keep the gaxios/native-fetch auth-stack path tracked separately?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the issue discussion includes credentialed Vertex failures across multiple releases and a separate dependency/auth-stack failure path that source-only wrapper tests do not settle.

options.title: Require live provider proof
options.body: Keep the issue and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/83991 open until a redacted Vertex or Gemini CLI run proves the sanitizer path on the exact head, while keeping the auth-stack path separate.

options.title: Accept proof override for sanitizer
options.body: A provider owner can explicitly accept source-level sanitizer proof, land the narrow PR, and leave this issue open until a follow-up proves the gaxios/native-fetch path is gone or separately fixed.

options.title: Defer sanitizer and prioritize auth stack
options.body: Pause the sanitizer PR and first pursue a dependency/auth-stack fix if maintainers believe the recent v2026.6.11 reproductions are primarily gaxios/node-fetch driven.

recommendation.title: Require live provider proof
recommendation.body: Keep the issue and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/83991 open until a redacted Vertex or Gemini CLI run proves the sanitizer path on the exact head, while keeping the auth-stack path separate.

likelyOwner.reason: He has recent ownership of both the Google thinking helper boundary and earlier Vertex ADC transport work, making him the best available owner for the proof/merge threshold decision.
